# truenas_nvmet_port (Resource)

Manages an NVMe-oF transport port on TrueNAS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_nvmet_port" "tcp" {
  addr_trtype  = "TCP"
  addr_traddr  = "192.0.2.10" # the box IP NVMe-oF should listen on
  addr_trsvcid = 4420
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `addr_traddr` (String) Transport address (IP address) the port listens on.
- `addr_trtype` (String) TCP or RDMA. Fibre Channel is not supported by this provider.

### Optional

- `addr_trsvcid` (Number) Transport service ID (TCP/RDMA port number). Defaults to 4420.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Cannot change an enabled port while the NVMe target service is running.
- `inline_data_size` (Number) Inline data size (bytes) for this port.
- `max_queue_size` (Number) Maximum queue size for this port.
- `pi_enable` (Boolean) Enable end-to-end data protection (PI) for this port.

### Read-Only

- `addr_adrfam` (String) Address family (e.g. IPV4) derived from addr_traddr.
- `id` (Number) Numeric NVMe-oF port ID assigned by TrueNAS.
- `index` (Number) Numeric index assigned by TrueNAS for this port.
